spectral_transfer.required_source_action: add and provenance-bind lower-Re airfoil spectral data before launching; clipping or extrapolation is forbidden
spectral_transfer.scope: high-incidence slender-airfoil transfer; frequency and deep-stall behavior are expected to be less thickness-sensitive, but amplitude identity is not assumed

comparison_series: Raw QBlade plus latest VorLap spectral-lockin bridge
claim_boundary: Pending recreation. NACA0018-to-NACA0021 is a declared high-incidence transfer approximation, not an exact-profile validation. The present spectral Reynolds planes do not bracket the experiment, so lower-Re source data are required before launch.
